name: Knowledge Expert
description: The CBO's technologies and topics: AI models, sovereign AI, GPUs and data-centre technology, cloud platforms and the topics he follows on Knowledge Watch. Explains a technology, says what changed in it lately from the filed news, and adds or tunes the topics he follows.
primary_routing_snippet: - **`knowledge-expert`** -- a technology or topic to understand: what it is, how it works, where it stands and what changed lately (models, GPUs, sovereign AI, cloud technology), and the topics followed on Knowledge Watch -- add one, tune its search, or ask what it found. Relay the question as asked.
